subject.title: [Feature]: Expose sessionKey/runId to outbound message hook for deterministic verification

question: What bounded Plugin SDK contract should `message_sending` expose for deterministic pre-send verification: run/session identifiers only, a recent transcript/tool evidence view, or a broader versioned outbound policy API?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but exposing session transcripts, tool calls, or tool results to pre-send plugins is a public API and security-boundary choice that automation should not make alone.

options.title: Define Bounded Evidence Contract
options.body: Expose `runId` plus a permissioned, size-capped recent evidence view for outbound hooks, with docs and SDK tests.

options.title: Keep Identifiers Only
options.body: Limit this issue to outbound `runId` and `messageId`, and track tool evidence through a separate verifier API.

options.title: Fold Into Policy API
options.body: Move this issue under a broader versioned outbound policy boundary instead of expanding `message_sending` directly.

recommendation.title: Define Bounded Evidence Contract
recommendation.body: Expose `runId` plus a permissioned, size-capped recent evidence view for outbound hooks, with docs and SDK tests.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest current history on hook correlation and diagnostic trace API foundations that would shape the public Plugin SDK contract.
